title: The C.I.A. Spy Inside the Kremlin

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 免费直播精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得一个月的免费权限，畅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不会想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Last week, CNN broke the story that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 上周，美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）爆出一条新闻：美国

sentences.en: had secretly exfiltrated a top spy from Russia back in 2017.
sentences.zh: 在2017年秘密撤出了一名来自俄罗斯的顶级间谍。

sentences.en: What that means now for U.S.
sentences.zh: 这现在对美国的

sentences.en: intelligence.
sentences.zh: 情报工作意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月16日，星期一。

sentences.en: So, Julian, tell me about this story that you had been reporting out.
sentences.zh: 那么，朱利安，跟我讲讲你一直在报道的这个故事吧。

sentences.en: A few months ago, my colleague Adam Goldman and I started doing some reporting about a key CIA asset who had been offered exfiltration from Russia by the CIA.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我的同事亚当·戈德曼和我开始着手报道一个关键的中央情报局（CIA）资产，他曾被 CIA 提出撤离俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And we knew that this source was the main person who told the CIA, who told the entire intelligence community that Vladimir Putin interfered in the election
sentences.zh: 我们知道这个消息源是主要向 CIA 以及整个情报界透露弗拉基米尔·普京干预选举的关键人物，

sentences.en: and favored Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 并且他偏袒唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So, this person was really important, and what happened to this person
sentences.zh: 所以，这个人非常重要，而这个人的遭遇

sentences.en: was a little bit of a mystery.
sentences.zh: 则成了一个谜。

sentences.en: Julian Barnes covers national security for The Times.
sentences.zh: 朱利安·巴恩斯负责《时报》的国家安全报道。

sentences.en: Anytime you're trying to report about sensitive intelligence, it's extremely slow going.
sentences.zh: 每当你试图报道敏感情报时，进展都会极其缓慢。

sentences.en: I had one conversation with a person who, as I was asking the question, he said, stop, I do not want to hear that question.
sentences.zh: 我曾跟一个人交谈过，当我正问到那个问题时，他说，停，我不想听那个问题。

sentences.en: I do not want you to ask me that question.
sentences.zh: 我不想你问我那个问题。

sentences.en: So, it's very painstaking work.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是非常煞费苦心的工作。

sentences.en: But last week, as I was doing reporting, I learned that a cable network was on to one of the stories I was working on.
sentences.zh: 但上周，当我正在做报道时，我得知一家有线电视网正在跟进我正在报道的一个故事。

sentences.en: But it was Friday, and I was nervous, but I let that go.
sentences.zh: 当时是星期五，我很紧张，但我还是放下了这件事。

sentences.en: Cross your fingers and went home for the day.
sentences.zh: 祈祷着好运，然后就回家过周末了。

sentences.en: Cross your fingers, go home.
sentences.zh: 祈祷好运，回家。

sentences.en: And Monday morning, I got a call that CNN was going to report the story.
sentences.zh: 星期一早上，我接到一个电话，说 CNN 要报道这个故事。

sentences.en: Good morning, I'm Jim Sciutto in New York.
sentences.zh: 早上好，我是身在纽约的吉姆·舒托。

sentences.en: And I'm Poppy Harlow.
sentences.zh: 我是波比·哈洛。

sentences.en: We're so glad you're with us this Monday morning, and we do begin with a really significant CNN exclusive.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴你能在这个周一早晨陪伴我们，而我们首先要报道一个非常重磅的 CNN 独家新闻。

sentences.en: And I was like, uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，啊哦。

sentences.en: And Jim, this is your reporting.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，这是你的报道。

sentences.en: You have learned about a highly secretive intelligence operation by the United States.
sentences.zh: 你获悉了一起美国高度机密的情报行动。

sentences.en: That's right, Poppy.
sentences.zh: 没错，波比。

sentences.en: Multiple Trump administration officials with direct knowledge tell me that in a previously undisclosed secret mission in 2017, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 多位对该事件有直接了解的特朗普政府官员告诉我，在2017年一次此前未公开的秘密任务中，美国

sentences.en: successfully extracted from Russia one of its highest-level covert sources inside the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 成功从俄罗斯撤出了其在俄罗斯政府内部级别最高的一名秘密情报源。

sentences.en: And then what happens?
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So it was not long after CNN broke the news that Russia apparently released the spy's name.
sentences.zh: 所以在 CNN 爆出这条新闻后不久，俄罗斯显然就公开了这个间谍的名字。

sentences.en: We have not confirmed the name of the spy, nor will we repeat the name the Russians revealed.
sentences.zh: 我们没有证实这个间谍的名字，也不会重复俄罗斯人透露的名字。

sentences.en: At first, when this happens, you think, oh, it's Russian disinformation.
sentences.zh: 起初，当这种事情发生时，你会想，哦，这是俄罗斯的虚假宣传。

sentences.en: But then you start a quick Google search, and looks like this guy was a diplomat.
sentences.zh: 但接着你开始快速进行谷歌搜索，看起来这家伙曾是一名外交官。

sentences.en: Looks like this guy was a diplomat in the United States at some point.
sentences.zh: 看起来这家伙在某个时候曾是驻美国的的外交官。

sentences.en: And lo and behold, there's a deed for a house in the Virginia suburbs.
sentences.zh: 结果，还真在弗吉尼亚州郊区找到了一处房产契约。

sentences.en: So you just Google the name of this spy, and oddly enough, an address pops up for what appears to be a senior Russian official working with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以你只要谷歌搜索这个间谍的名字，奇怪的是，就会弹出一个地址，似乎属于一个与美国合作的高级俄罗斯官员。

sentences.en: What do you actually do with that information?
sentences.zh: 你到底要怎么处理这些信息？

sentences.en: So it's sort of shocking to find that.
sentences.zh: 所以发现这一点让人有点震惊。

sentences.en: It's just profoundly weird.
sentences.zh: 这简直匪夷所思。

sentences.en: Like, this is not how it's supposed to work.
sentences.zh: 就像，事情本不该是这样的。

sentences.en: Like, Russia is not supposed to release the name of the spy.
sentences.zh: 就像，俄罗斯本不应该泄露间谍的名字。

sentences.en: Like, you're not supposed to Google the spy in your backyard.
sentences.zh: 就像，你不应该在自己后院谷歌搜索间谍。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But what you do with that information is you drive out and pay a visit.
sentences.zh: 但你对这些信息能做的就是开车过去拜访一下。

sentences.en: And so the next morning, the family car was in use, so I rented a car-to-go, which is this very small smart car, which you're not supposed to take on the highway.
sentences.zh: 于是第二天早上，家里的车正在用，所以我租了一辆 Car2Go，那是一种非常小的微型车，本来是不准开上高速公路的。

sentences.en: But I discovered you can achieve speeds of 65 miles an hour with a very, very small smart car.
sentences.zh: 但我发现，开着一辆非常非常小的微型车，竟然也能开到每小时65英里的速度。

sentences.en: You're in a classic spy thriller car, right?
sentences.zh: 你开的是一辆经典的谍战惊悚片里的车，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, it's not like you're sneaking up when you drive in basically a clown car to somebody's house.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当你基本上开着一辆小丑车去别人家时，可谈不上什么潜行。

sentences.en: But I needn't thought, as I was weaving through the curvy roads of Virginia subdivisions, that I was going to surprise anyone.
sentences.zh: 但我当时在弗吉尼亚州那些弯弯曲曲的住宅区道路穿行时，并不觉得自己会惊动任何人。

sentences.en: Because when I arrived at the house, there was a half-dozen other reporters there.
sentences.zh: 因为当我到达那栋房子时，那里已经有大半打其他记者了。

sentences.en: So I parked my car, said hello to my rival at the Washington Post, and then I walked up the driveway.
sentences.zh: 所以我把车停好，跟我在《华盛顿邮报》的竞争对手打了个招呼，然后朝车道走去。

sentences.en: I'm walking down to the cul-de-sac where you can see the house.
sentences.zh: 我顺着尽头是环岛的街道走去，在那里可以看到那栋房子。

sentences.en: It has a big porch, three stories, very large house.
sentences.zh: 它有一个大门廊，三层楼，非常大的房子。

sentences.en: I just remember being, like, surprised, like, these are huge houses.
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时感到很惊讶，心想，这些房子太大了。

sentences.en: It's pretty good to be a spy, I guess.
sentences.zh: 当间谍感觉还挺不错的，我猜。

sentences.en: Lawn has been freshly mowed, and the little cuttings are still on the driveway here.
sentences.zh: 草坪刚修剪过，草屑还在车道上。

sentences.en: So I walked up to the house.
sentences.zh: 所以我走向房子。

sentences.en: A lot of windows right here on the porch.
sentences.zh: 门廊这里有很多窗户。

sentences.en: You know, someone has been in here and has drawn the shutters.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有人在里面拉上了百叶窗。

sentences.en: I walked up earlier, and you could see inside.
sentences.zh: 我刚才走近时还能看到里面。

sentences.en: And now you can't.
sentences.zh: 现在看不到了。

sentences.en: They've drawn the drapes.
sentences.zh: 他们把窗帘拉上了。

sentences.en: There's children's toys visible in the backyard, waiting pool.
sentences.zh: 后院可以看到儿童玩具，还有一个戏水池。

sentences.en: There's the card from another reporter left in the door.
sentences.zh: 门上留着另一位记者的名片。

sentences.en: I'm going to ring the bell.
sentences.zh: 我要按门铃了。

sentences.en: And then without thinking, I put my hand on the doorknob, and then I just instantly thought, oh, man, Russia is known for going after spies by coating doorknobs with nerve agents.
sentences.zh: 然后我下意识地把手放在了门把手上，紧接着我突然想到，天哪，俄罗斯可是出了名地喜欢在门把手上涂抹神经毒剂来追杀间谍。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you just touched the doorknob.
sentences.zh: 而你刚刚碰了门把手。

sentences.en: And I just touched the doorknob.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚碰了门把手。

sentences.en: But of course you're fine.
sentences.zh: 但当然你没事。

sentences.en: I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 我没事。

sentences.en: Momentary scare.
sentences.zh: 虚惊一场。

sentences.en: The garbage bin is left out front.
sentences.zh: 垃圾桶被遗弃在正门前。

sentences.en: The neighbors had said that there was a dog left behind, and the sheriff was supposed to come look.
sentences.zh: 邻居们说这里留下一只狗，治安官本该来看看的。

sentences.en: But nobody was home.
sentences.zh: 但家里没有人。

sentences.en: But I wanted to figure out what happened, so I walked down the driveway, crossed the cul-de-sac, and tried to meet some of the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 不过我想弄清楚发生了什么，所以我顺着车道走下来，穿过环岛，试图去见几位邻居。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm with the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是《纽约时报》的。

sentences.en: I'm Julian Barnes.
sentences.zh: 我是朱利安·巴恩斯。

sentences.en: I'm doing some reporting about the neighbor.
sentences.zh: 我正在做关于这位邻居的一些报道。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I don't know if you saw the press reports or whatnot, but there was reports broke out in my paper in CNN yesterday about the informant who told about Russian meddling.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们有没有看到昨天我的报纸和 CNN 上关于那个揭露俄罗斯干预行为的线人的新闻报道。

sentences.en: And Russian media, Russian government is reporting it, is your next-door neighbor.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯媒体和俄罗斯政府报道说，你们的隔壁邻居就是这个人。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what do they know?
sentences.zh: 他们都知道些什么？

sentences.en: Well, you know, when you're reporting about somebody and talking to the neighbors, the classic journalistic joke was, they were very quiet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，当你报道某个人并与邻居交谈时，经典的记者笑话就是，他们非常安静。

sentences.en: I remember them being new neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们是新搬来的邻居。

sentences.en: We hadn't even met them.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至都没见过他们。

sentences.en: They needed to get over.
sentences.zh: 他们本该过来打个招呼的。

sentences.en: Didn't get over.
sentences.zh: 结果没过来。

sentences.en: And, of course, stereotypically, you know, we heard they were very quiet.
sentences.zh: 当然，按刻板印象来说，你知道的，我们听说他们非常安静。

sentences.en: But one of the neighbors described...
sentences.zh: 但其中一位邻居描述说……

sentences.en: July 4th, we're shooting off fireworks, and I'm like, oh, crap, there's the neighbor, the wife and the kids sitting on the front porch.
sentences.zh: 7月4日我们在放烟花，然后我想，哦，糟了，邻居的妻子和孩子们正坐在前廊上。

sentences.en: So I said, let me go over and invite them.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，我去邀请他们过来吧。

sentences.en: Inviting them over for the 4th of July fireworks.
sentences.zh: 邀请他们过来观看7月4日的烟花。

sentences.en: So I went over to invite them, and she said she didn't speak English.
sentences.zh: 所以我过去邀请他们，她说她不会说英语。

sentences.en: So her husband came out and said that they would just watch from the steps.
sentences.zh: 于是她丈夫出来说他们就在台阶上看就好了。

sentences.en: The interactions were a little bit few and far between?
sentences.zh: 你们之间的互动有点少得可怜吗？

sentences.en: That was the only interaction with him, other than just waving when we passed on the street.
sentences.zh: 那是跟他唯一的互动，除了在街上擦肩而过时挥手致意之外。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 原来如此。

sentences.en: We was walking the dog, or I'd wave when I'd seen him go in the yard.
sentences.zh: 我们在遛狗时，或者我看到他进院子时会向他挥手。

sentences.en: I did stop, and his wife was walking the dog, and I stopped and just said, hi, how you doing?
sentences.zh: 我有一次停下来，当时他妻子在遛狗，我停下来打招呼说，嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: And she just, I don't think she understood me, because she said, fine, fine, fine.
sentences.zh: 她只是——我觉得她没听懂我的话，因为她说，很好，很好，很好。

sentences.en: I said, how do you like the house in the neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 我说，你觉得这栋房子和这个社区怎么样？

sentences.en: And she's like, fine, fine, fine.
sentences.zh: 她说，很好，很好，很好。

sentences.en: You know, so I'm like, I don't know if you understand me or not, but that was the only time I've ever talked to either one of them.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以我心想，我不知道你听不听得懂我说话，但那是唯一一次我跟他们俩中任何一个人说过话。

sentences.en: But, you know, the details they did provide really seemed to confirm that this was our guy, that this was the spy.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，他们确实提供了一些细节，似乎真的证实了这就是我们要找的人，这就是那个间谍。

sentences.en: It was a Russian couple, and I remember two kids, a taller boy.
sentences.zh: 那是一对俄罗斯夫妇，我记得有两个孩子，一个较高的男孩。

sentences.en: There may have been three, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 可能还有三个，我不知道。

sentences.en: The family moved in in June of 2018.
sentences.zh: 这家人是2018年6月搬进来的。

sentences.en: They were vague about where they came from, just saying they had moved from northern Virginia.
sentences.zh: 他们对来自哪里语焉不详，只说他们是从弗吉尼亚州北部搬过来的。

sentences.en: I know there was at least one little kid, and then the other kid was, I don't know if he was junior high or high school.
sentences.zh: 我知道至少有一个小孩，另一个孩子，我不知道他是上初中还是高中。

sentences.en: The husband was friendly, but spoke in what everyone knew was a heavy Russian accent.
sentences.zh: 丈夫很友好，但每个人都听得出他带有浓重的俄罗斯口音。

sentences.en: He was a diplomat for many years, so I presume his English was pretty good.
sentences.zh: 他做过多年外交官，所以我猜他的英语相当不错。

sentences.en: Was that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, he definitely had an accent that I could understand real good.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，他确实带着我能听得很清楚的口音。

sentences.en: And one of the neighbors told me that they had been whisked away the night before.
sentences.zh: 其中一位邻居告诉我，他们在前一天晚上被悄悄带走了。

sentences.en: A van came up, loaded them up, and took them to a location unknown.
sentences.zh: 一辆面包车开过来，把他们装上车，带到了一个未知地点。

sentences.en: Did these neighbors that you were talking to seem shocked by this seeming spy in their midst?
sentences.zh: 你交谈的这些邻居，对他们中间潜伏着这样一个疑似间谍感到震惊吗？

sentences.en: You know, oddly, they didn't.
sentences.zh: 你知道，奇怪的是，他们并没有。

sentences.en: It's a little bit spy novel-ish, but it's how the world works.
sentences.zh: 这有点像间谍小说里的情节，但这就是现实世界的运作方式。

sentences.en: So, I mean, you know, we do it to them, they do it to us.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我们对他们这样做，他们对我们这样做。

sentences.en: One person was like, we live near Washington.
sentences.zh: 有人说，我们住在华盛顿附近。

sentences.en: There are a lot of spies around here.
sentences.zh: 这周围有很多间谍。

sentences.en: It's government, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这就是政府。

sentences.en: It's every government.
sentences.zh: 每个政府都这样。

sentences.en: And they seemed to very quickly process that this neighbor, who they didn't know very well, that he had been a spy.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎很快就接受了这样一个事实：这个他们不太熟悉的邻居，其实一直是个间谍。

sentences.en: And one of the neighbors was pretty outspoken and turned out to be pretty proud of his neighbor and said,
sentences.zh: 其中一位邻居相当直言不讳，结果证明他对自己的邻居还挺自豪的，他说：

sentences.en: My only concern is, if the guy's on our side, I don't know how to go.
sentences.zh: 我唯一的顾虑是，如果这家伙是我们这边的人，我不知道事情会怎么发展。

sentences.en: We're doing him any favors.
sentences.zh: 我们在帮他任何忙吗？

sentences.en: This guy was doing important work for America.
sentences.zh: 这家伙在为美国做着重要的工作。

sentences.en: And, you know, he had really risked his own life to do good for our country.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他真的是冒着生命危险为我们的国家做好事。

sentences.en: So we didn't know our neighbor was a spy, but now that we know he was a spy for us, for the good guys, rah-rah.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道我们的邻居是个间谍，但既然我们知道他是为我们、为好人当间谍的，那就太棒了，加油！

sentences.en: Exactly, which is a pretty quick mental somersault to do, I think.
sentences.zh: 没错，我觉得这在心理上是个相当快的急转弯。

sentences.en: But, yeah, that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，事情就是这样。

sentences.en: They quickly thought, all right, he's on our side.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就想通了：好吧，他是我们这边的人。

sentences.en: Let's rally around the flag for him.
sentences.zh: 让我们为他摇旗呐喊吧。

sentences.en: So then what happens?
sentences.zh: 那接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: After a few hours, the postman drives up, and he is immediately mobbed by six reporters.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，邮递员开车过来，立刻被六名记者围住了。

sentences.en: And then I just look at that scene, and I think, the postman doesn't know anything.
sentences.zh: 当时我看着那个场景，心想，这个邮递员什么也不知道。

sentences.en: This is over.
sentences.zh: 这就结束了。

sentences.en: So I got back into my car, and I headed back to the New York Times-Washington Bureau to keep reporting.
sentences.zh: 于是我回到车里，开车返回《纽约时报》华盛顿分社继续进行报道。

sentences.en: And presumably drop off your car-to-go at its car-to-go place?
sentences.zh: 顺便把你的共享汽车停到它的停车点？

sentences.en: You can just leave them anywhere in the District of Columbia.
sentences.zh: 你可以在哥伦比亚特区的任何地方归还它们。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免登录？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，即可享受首月免费体验。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，今天就下载《时报》App，即可获得30天免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: All right, Julian, how did we get here?
sentences.zh: 好的，朱利安，我们是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: What's the story?
sentences.zh: 来龙去脉是怎样的？

sentences.en: So decades ago, the CIA approached a low-level or mid-level Russian diplomat with an offer to spy for the United States.
sentences.zh: 几十年前，中情局接触了一名俄罗斯低级或中级外交官，提出让他为美国进行间谍活动。

sentences.en: Now, we don't know exactly when or where that occurred.
sentences.zh: 目前我们还不清楚这件事发生的确切时间和地点。

sentences.en: But we do know that it was outside Russia because it's very difficult to approach, to cultivate a potential source inside Russia.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道它发生在俄罗斯境外，因为要在俄罗斯境内接触和发展潜在的情报来源非常困难。

sentences.en: Inside Russia, American spies are followed everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯境内，美国间谍无时无刻不在被跟踪。

sentences.en: So this approach occurred overseas.
sentences.zh: 所以这次接触发生在了海外。

sentences.en: And with this informant, the CIA really struck gold.
sentences.zh: 通过这个线人，中情局可以说是挖到了宝。

sentences.en: The informant rose to be an aid to a key diplomatic figure.
sentences.zh: 这名线人晋升为一个关键外交要员的助手。

sentences.en: The informant's patron was the chief diplomatic advisor to Putin.
sentences.zh: 线人的顶头上司正是普京的首席外交顾问。

sentences.en: And for the CIA, this is the critical thing.
sentences.zh: 对中情局来说，这才是至关重要的。

sentences.en: It's very hard to understand Vladimir Putin's thinking or his strategy.
sentences.zh: 要摸清弗拉基米尔·普京的想法或策略非常困难。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin is a former spy himself.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京本人就是前特工出身。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He is very careful.
sentences.zh: 他非常谨慎。

sentences.en: He does not communicate over cell phones, over landlines.
sentences.zh: 他不通过手机或座机进行沟通。

sentences.en: He does not write a lot of stuff down.
sentences.zh: 他很少把事情写下来。

sentences.en: He just knows those kinds of things are what get intercepted, recorded, photographed.
sentences.zh: 他很清楚这些东西会被拦截、录音和拍照。

sentences.en: And so when we're talking about Vladimir Putin, human intelligence, spies, informants are really, really critical.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们谈论弗拉基米尔·普京时，人力情报、间谍和线人就显得极为、极为关键。

sentences.en: By the time we get to the Obama administration, the reports coming from the informant are handled with the utmost sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 到了奥巴马政府时期，来自该线人的情报受到了极其敏感的对待。

sentences.en: There are reports for the president's eyes only, put into sealed envelopes, delivered to the Oval Office, and required to be returned to the CIA.
sentences.zh: 有些情报是仅供总统审阅的，装在密封信封里送进椭圆形办公室，并且必须归还给中情局。

sentences.en: Extraordinary levels of secrecy and protection that show how important this spy's information was.
sentences.zh: 这种非同寻常的保密和保护级别，足见这个间谍提供的情报有多么重要。

sentences.en: And by nurturing this informant over decades, watching him get ever better access, they developed what some people say is the CIA's most important source in 2016.
sentences.zh: 通过对这名线人数十年的悉心培养，看着他获得越来越核心的接触权限，他们打造出了人们口中2016年时中情局最重要的情报来源。

sentences.en: The New York Times reports on the growing FBI investigation into the Democratic National Committee email hack.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道了联邦调查局对民主党全国委员会电邮泄密事件不断深入的调查。

sentences.en: The agency reportedly is also trying to determine if aides and groups close to Hillary Clinton were targeted as well.
sentences.zh: 据报道，该机构还在试图查明希拉里·克林顿身边的助手和团体是否也成为了目标。

sentences.en: Secretary of State John Kerry this morning raised the issue with Russia's foreign minister.
sentences.zh: 国务卿约翰·克里今天上午向俄罗斯外长提出了这个问题。

sentences.en: The Russians scoffed at reports.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人对这些报道嗤之以鼻。

sentences.en: Moscow is behind the hack.
sentences.zh: 莫斯科是黑客事件的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: So this is where we are when the most difficult challenge to the American intelligence agencies in a generation develops,
sentences.zh: 这就是当美国情报机构面临整整一代人中最大难关时的处境，

sentences.en: where a adversarial power begins to interfere in an American election.
sentences.zh: 一个敌对大国开始干预美国大选。

sentences.en: What specifically do we know about the intelligence that this spy is able to get the U.S.
sentences.zh: 关于这名间谍在2016年能够为美国获取的情报，具体有哪些是我们知道的？

sentences.en: There are two pieces of intelligence that we know about that were really important, one of which is that...
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的有两份至关重要的情报，其中之一是……

sentences.en: Tonight, the Central Intelligence Agency is confident that a Russian hacking plot tried to influence the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今晚，美国中央情报局确信，俄罗斯曾策划黑客行动，试图干预美国总统大选以帮助唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: presidential election in favor of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 总统大选，支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Putin affirmatively wanted Donald Trump to be president.
sentences.zh: 普京从心底里希望唐纳德·特朗普当选总统。

sentences.en: There was something about Trump that Putin liked.
sentences.zh: 特朗普身上有某种特质是普京所欣赏的。

sentences.en: And this ultimately became a key finding of the CIA.
sentences.zh: 这最终成为了中情局的一个关键调查结论。

sentences.en: They had multiple sources for it.
sentences.zh: 他们有多个信息来源来支持这一点。

sentences.en: But this was the first source.
sentences.zh: 但这是最初的来源。

sentences.en: This was the most important source, we believe, for that finding.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这是得出该结论最核心的情报来源。

sentences.en: The other thing is that the source confirmed that the DNC hack, the Russian cyber penetration of the Democratic National Committee,
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，该消息源证实了民主党全国委员会（DNC）遭黑客攻击事件——即俄罗斯对民主党全国委员会的网络渗透——

sentences.en: had been ordered and approved by Vladimir Putin, that it was part of Putin's larger strategy.
sentences.zh: 是由弗拉基米尔·普京下令并批准的，这是普京宏大战略的一部分。

sentences.en: And to have this informant confirm that finding really allowed the CIA to have a high level of confidence in that.
sentences.zh: 能有这位线人证实这一结论，确实让中情局对该判断有了极高的信心。

sentences.en: That really shaped the understanding in 2016 about what had happened.
sentences.zh: 这真正塑造了2016年人们对所发生之事的认知。

sentences.en: In a memo to CIA staff, Director John Brennan said that he, FBI Director James Comey, and Director of National Intelligence James Clapper,
sentences.zh: 时任中情局局长约翰·布伦南在致中情局员工的一份备忘录中表示，他、联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米以及国家情报总监詹姆斯·克拉珀，

sentences.en: were now all on the same page about the scope, nature, and intent of the Russian interference in our presidential election.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯干预我们总统大选的范围、性质和意图上，现在已经达成了完全一致。

sentences.en: But there's a downside.
sentences.zh: 但也有不利的一面。

sentences.en: When you're delivering the most explosive, the most important intelligence, and that intelligence is entering the political debate.
sentences.zh: 当你发布最具爆炸性、最重要的情报，而这些情报又被卷入政治辩论之中时。

sentences.en: I think it's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: I think it's just another excuse.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这只是又一个借口。

sentences.en: I don't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我不相信。

sentences.en: There's a level of scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 审查达到了某种程度。

sentences.en: So we have to be very careful right now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在必须非常小心。

sentences.en: We cannot make these wild assumptions that the Russian government was behind this, because right now, we do not have all of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们不能做出这种毫无根据的假设，认为俄罗斯政府是幕后黑手，因为目前我们还没有掌握所有的证据。

sentences.en: Reporters start asking questions.
sentences.zh: 记者们开始提问。

sentences.en: We haven't been given a shred of evidence to substantiate the claim that the Russians were behind this.
sentences.zh: 我们没有得到哪怕一丝证据来证实俄罗斯是幕后黑手的说法。

sentences.en: Members of Congress start asking questions.
sentences.zh: 国会议员们开始提问。

sentences.en: People want to know, how does the CIA know this?
sentences.zh: 人们想知道，中情局是怎么知道这一点的？

sentences.en: And there are hints at the end of 2016 that the CIA has a source in Russia.
sentences.zh: 2016年底时有迹象表明，中情局在俄罗斯有一个内线。

sentences.en: New information, derived from diplomatic sources and spies working for U.S.
sentences.zh: 新的情报来源于外交渠道和为美国盟友效力的间谍，

sentences.en: allies, points directly to the Russian president.
sentences.zh: 直接指向了俄罗斯总统。

sentences.en: So despite all the secrecy and the care around this informant, his existence is suddenly something people understand.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管对这名线人的保护保密工作做得再严密，他的存在突然之间还是为人所知了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, if you go back and look at the stories at the end of 2016, they're just the lightest hints.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你回头看2016年底的报道，那里面只有极其微弱的暗示。

sentences.en: But the CIA is getting nervous because the CIA knows when reporters are asking questions, so too are the Russians.
sentences.zh: 但中情局开始感到紧张，因为中情局知道，既然记者们在提问，俄罗斯人也一定在提问。

sentences.en: And Putin is ruthless about people he considers traitors.
sentences.zh: 而普京对那些他认为是叛徒的人是绝不手软的。

sentences.en: So they begin to write a plan to extract the informant from Russia.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始制定计划，将这名线人从俄罗斯撤离。

sentences.en: And as the news stories increased in early 2017...
sentences.zh: 随着2017年初新闻报道的增多……

sentences.en: This morning, a Washington Post investigation focuses on Russian government interference in our election.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，《华盛顿邮报》的一篇调查报道聚焦于俄罗斯政府对我们大选的干预。

sentences.en: In August, the CIA gave then-President Obama a report, quote, drawn from sourcing deep inside the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 今年8月，中情局向时任总统奥巴马提交了一份报告，引述自“深入俄罗斯政府内部的情报源”。

sentences.en: The CIA went to the spy and said, it's time to go.
sentences.zh: 中情局找到这名间谍，对他说，是时候离开了。

sentences.en: You need to come to America.
sentences.zh: 你需要去美国。

sentences.en: That offer was accepted.
sentences.zh: 这个提议被接受了。

sentences.en: So, Julian, the spy is in the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以，朱利安，这个间谍现在在美国。

sentences.en: I guess we didn't know it at the time, but he's in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时并不知道，但他现在在弗吉尼亚州。

sentences.en: How do you come to get on this story a few months back?
sentences.zh: 几个月前你是怎么开始着手这篇报道的？

sentences.en: So, in 2018, I started reporting about why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 2018年，我开始报道为什么美国似乎对俄罗斯意图或干预中期选举的策略缺乏清晰的了解。

sentences.en: seemed to have not a very good understanding about what Russia's intentions or strategy for interfering in the midterm elections would be.
sentences.zh: 中期选举的策略是什么。

sentences.en: There was assumptions that they were going to do it, but the intelligence community didn't have a high level of confidence about exactly what would be going on.
sentences.zh: 当时人们猜测他们会这么做，但情报界对于具体会发生什么并没有十足的把握。

sentences.en: So, we wrote a story about how the CIA's assets in Russia had gone dark and that they no longer had eyes on the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 于是我们写了一篇报道，讲述中情局在俄罗斯的资产已经陷入黑暗，他们对克里姆林宫失去了监控。

sentences.en: Now, at that time, we didn't know exactly why that was, and that story sort of speculated that there was a number of different reasons why the spies could have gone silent.
sentences.zh: 当时，我们并不完全清楚原因何在，那篇报道只是推测间谍失联可能有各种各样的原因。

sentences.en: But what we didn't know is that the really good spy had been brought out.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道的是，这个真正厉害的间谍已经被撤出来了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: It's sort of amazing that you could tell even from the outside that something had changed and that what had changed turned out to be the absence of a single person.
sentences.zh: 这真有点神奇，你甚至能从外部看出有什么发生了变化，而发生的变化竟然是一个关键人物的缺席。

sentences.en: So, how common is that for a country like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，像美国这样一个国家，在像俄罗斯这样战略地位极其重要的地方，如此高度依赖单一情报源，这种情况有多常见？

sentences.en: to be so reliant on a single source in a place as important strategically as Russia?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯这样战略地位重要的地方？

sentences.en: Now, of course, there are multiple sources.
sentences.zh: 当然，情报来源不止一个。

sentences.en: You can't have high confidence in a conclusion and still have one source.
sentences.zh: 你不可能只有一个情报源，却对某个结论抱有高度信心。

sentences.en: But this source is probably the most important one because of the access to the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 但这个情报源可能是最重要的一个，因为他能接触到克里姆林宫核心。

sentences.en: And the reality is in this day and age, it is very hard to develop good sources.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，在这个时代，培养优秀的情报源非常困难。

sentences.en: As this story shows, it takes decades.
sentences.zh: 正如这篇报道所展示的，这需要几十年的时间。

sentences.en: It took years to cultivate this person, to get this person into a place where they could offer the highest and most valuable level of intelligence.
sentences.zh: 培养这个人花了数年时间，才把他送到了能够提供最高价值、最核心级别情报的位置。

sentences.en: You don't turn around and develop a spy in a year.
sentences.zh: 你不可能转眼间就在一年内培养出一个间谍。

sentences.en: You don't get a high-ranking Kremlin official to just turn and give you the crown jewels.
sentences.zh: 你不可能让一个克里姆林宫的高官说叛变就叛变，还把最高机密拱手相送。

sentences.en: And in Russia, the kinds of technical intelligence that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯，美国在许多地方赖以依仗的那种技术情报，

sentences.en: relies on in so many places, eavesdropping, signals intelligence, spy satellites, the Russians are very sophisticated at sort of blocking some of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 窃听、信号情报、间谍卫星，俄罗斯人在屏蔽这些东西方面非常老道。

sentences.en: And so, that puts so much importance on the old-school human spies.
sentences.zh: 因此，这让老式的人力间谍变得极为重要。

sentences.en: Everything you just said does not seem to bode very well for our intelligence on Russia with the 2020 election approaching.
sentences.zh: 随着2020年大选的临近，你刚才所说的一切似乎对我们关于俄罗斯的情报工作不是个好兆头。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That's what's really important about this story.
sentences.zh: 这就是这篇报道真正重要的地方。

sentences.en: Going forward, looking at the 2020 election, when everyone believes that Russia will mount another interference campaign, we know that they'll do that.
sentences.zh: 展望未来，放眼2020年大选，当所有人都相信俄罗斯会发动又一次干预行动时，我们知道他们会的。

sentences.en: But we don't know how they'll do it.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道他们会怎么做。

sentences.en: They're going to use different tactics than they used before.
sentences.zh: 他们会采用与以往不同的战术。

sentences.en: And if you don't have the eyes on the ground, you don't have an early warning system.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有地面上的观察力量，你就没有预警系统。

sentences.en: You don't know what Russia is going to do.
sentences.zh: 你不知道俄罗斯要做什么。

sentences.en: You don't know what Putin himself is ordering.
sentences.zh: 你不知道普京本人下达了什么命令。

sentences.en: Julian, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 朱利安，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's been a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸。

sentences.en: After an interview with The Times, James Clapper, the director of national intelligence under President Obama,
sentences.zh: 在接受《时报》采访后，奥巴马总统时期的国家情报总监詹姆斯·克拉珀

sentences.en: said there was little doubt that this past week's revelations were going to, quote, make recruiting assets in Russia even more difficult than it already is.
sentences.zh: 表示，过去一周的爆料“毫无疑问会使在俄罗斯招募情报资产变得比以前更加困难”。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Sunday night,
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，

sentences.en: President Trump said he was prepared to take military action in response to a series of devastating attacks on Saudi Arabia's oil production system over the weekend,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，鉴于沙特阿拉伯石油生产系统在周末遭到一系列毁灭性打击，他已准备好采取军事行动，

sentences.en: which knocked out about half the kingdom's oil output and sent global oil prices soaring.
sentences.zh: 这些袭击瘫痪了沙特大约一半的石油产量，并导致全球油价飙升。

sentences.en: Responsibility for the attacks was claimed by the Houthi rebels in Yemen, who have been engaged in a years-long battle with Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 也门胡塞武装声称对袭击负责，该组织与沙特阿拉伯进行了长达数年的交战。

sentences.en: But U.S.
sentences.zh: 但美国

sentences.en: intelligence suggested that the attack was actually conducted by Iran, potentially escalating an already tense standoff with the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 情报显示，袭击实际上是由伊朗实施的，这可能会使本已紧张的特朗普政府对峙局势进一步升级。

sentences.en: Iran denied any role in the attack, but in a tweet, President Trump wrote that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 伊朗否认与袭击有任何关系，但特朗普总统在推特上写道，美国

sentences.en: was, quote, locked and loaded, depending on verification of Iran's role.
sentences.zh: 已经“箭在弦上，蓄势待发”，具体将取决于对伊朗角色的核实。

sentences.en: And an investigation by two reporters at The Times has further corroborated the allegation that while a student at Yale,
sentences.zh: 《时报》两名记者的调查进一步证实了这样一项指控：最高法院大法官布雷特·卡瓦诺在耶鲁大学就读期间，

sentences.en: Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh pulled down his pants at a party and thrust his penis at a female classmate, Deborah Ramirez.
sentences.zh: 曾在一次聚会上脱下裤子，将生殖器凑向一名女同学黛博拉·拉米雷斯。

sentences.en: Kavanaugh denied the claim during his confirmation hearings, but the reporters found that at least seven people, including Ramirez's mother,
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺在提名听证会上否认了这一指控，但记者们发现，包括拉米雷斯的母亲在内的至少七个人，

sentences.en: had heard about the incident before Kavanaugh became a federal judge, two of them just days after the incident had occurred.
sentences.zh: 早在卡瓦诺成为联邦法官之前就听说过这件事，其中两人在事件发生几天后就知道了。

sentences.en: The reporters also found a Yale classmate who said that Kavanaugh had thrust his penis into the hand of a different female student.
sentences.zh: 记者们还找到了一位耶鲁同窗，称卡瓦诺曾将自己的生殖器塞进另一位女学生的手中。

sentences.en: That classmate reported the incident to the FBI before Kavanaugh was confirmed.
sentences.zh: 这位同窗在卡瓦诺通过提名确认前向联邦调查局举报了此事。

sentences.en: But the FBI did not investigate the claim.
sentences.zh: 但联邦调查局并未对该指控进行调查。

sentences.en: On Sunday, The Times reported that the Justice Department will present one of its most prestigious awards for distinguished service to the lawyers who worked to confirm Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 周日，《时报》报道称，司法部将把其最负盛名的杰出服务奖授予为卡瓦诺确认提名而工作的律师们。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《割草机秀》中，我们将为节日期间的聚会做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，了解如何让您的客宾至如归。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是全黑睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片了才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用或您喜欢的任何地方收听 The Wirecutter Show。
